# Invitation Maker

Invitation maker: wedding, birthday, baby shower and party invitations and greeting cards, generated with your details spelled out.

## What it does
Give the occasion, the main line, the details and a style. Claude tells you the price and creates the card.

**How the files are made:** The files are generated by image, video and audio models that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you ask, and the price in credits is shown first.

Image files in portrait; short, exact text works best.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install invitation-maker@megascenes
```

## Setup
The plugin connects Claude to the MegaScenes MCP server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/invitation/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting asks you to sign in to MegaScenes (OAuth with PKCE); you can create an account on the same page, and you come straight back to the chat.
- Creating uses the credits on your MegaScenes account, and the price is shown before anything runs. New accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Where Claude supports interactive apps, results appear in a live viewer; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_invitation_models` | Models for invitations with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_invitation_cost` | Exact price of one invitation before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_invitation` | Starts one invitation in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_invitation` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "An elegant floral wedding invitation for Anna & Luca, June 12, Villa Rosa"
- "A playful 30th birthday party invitation"
- "A baby shower invitation in soft blue, Saturday at 3 pm"

## Data and privacy
Your prompts, settings and the files you choose are sent to MegaScenes and kept in your MegaScenes account, and they are sent to the model provider that makes the file. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
